title: Deep Learning for Dynamic Programming with Recursive Utility Using First-order Conditions
summary: This paper proposes the certainty-equivalent first-order learning (CEFOL) algorithm, a deep learning algorithm for solving discrete-time dynamic programming problems with recursive utility. Dynamic programming with recursive utility is challenging because nonlinear certainty equivalent appears in the Bellman equation and the first-order optimality conditions but is difficult to evaluate. By introducing a separate neural network to represent the certainty equivalent, CEFOL enables the exploitation of the Bellman and model-specific first-order optimality conditions.
